title: feat(console): registering from an invitation link joins its organization and enters the app in one step
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuAQiU42K9ti2tKWY4RZ6E6h)_

Part of #30125 (item 2 here; item 4 landed in PR #30490; items 1 and 3 moved to #30206; item 5 is the devx lane's and stays on the card).

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：被邀请人从邀请链接注册后，注册页直接接受这份邀请、切到该组织并进入应用；不再先停在「接受邀请」页、再停在「邀请已接受 … 继续」页。控制台自己的注册页和 app-shell 的 `DefaultRegisterPage` 行为一致。
- 为什么改：卡片 #30125 第 2 项，通过邀请加入要走三屏；在 main `c045c341` 真栈上实测属实（注册 → 接受邀请 → 邀请已接受·继续 → 应用）。
- 风险与回滚：接受仍由服务端判定，只针对该链接里的那一份邀请，且只在本页刚注册出的会话上发生；打开页面时已登录的人什么都不接受；邮箱不符时服务端照常 403，页面转到原来的接受页显示拒绝。无数据迁移，回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/invitationSignUpJoin.ts`（何时算同意）、`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/RegisterPage.tsx` 注册后编排里的 `invitationJoin` 分支、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/RegisterPage.tsx` 的 `if (user …)` 三行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/invitationSignUpJoin-30125.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/__tests__/invitationSignUpJoin-30125.test.tsx`，预期 6 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Card #30125, **item 2**: joining by invitation took three screens (register, "Accept invitation", "Invitation accepted … Continue").

- **`@object-ui/app-shell`: `useInvitationSignUpJoin(redirect)`** (new export, with type `InvitationSignUpJoin`), in `console/auth/invitationSignUpJoin.ts`. It applies only when the page's `?redirect=` names an invitation (`invitationIdOf`, the same reading as `isInvitationRedirect`) AND the session appeared on the page: the first answered session check found nobody signed in (latched during render, since `isLoading` is raised again by the sign-up in flight). It then reads the invitation (`get-invitation`), accepts it (`accept-invitation`), and switches the session to its organization, once per invitation id. Answers `none`, `joining`, `joined`, or `refused` (any throw before the acceptance lands).
- **`@object-ui/console`: `/register`**: the post-sign-up effect holds while `joining`, and on `joined` makes one full-page navigation to the console root (`withConsoleBase('/')`), the way the accept page's Continue does; `refused` falls through to today's steps, which open the accept page, where the server's refusal is shown.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`: `DefaultRegisterPage`**: the same hook. It used to go to `/` after the sign-up and leave the invitation behind; now `joining`/`joined` hold an empty layout, `joined` enters `resolveRootUrl()`, and `refused` navigates to the accept page. A visitor signed in when the page opens still goes to `/` (objectui#11714 unchanged). `onSuccess` no longer navigates for an invitation sign-up, so it cannot race the join.
- No new i18n keys: the wait is the pages' existing spinner or empty layout. No server change: `get-invitation`, `accept-invitation` and `set-active` are the routes the accept page already calls.
- **Changeset**: `.changeset/30125-invitation-sign-up-joins.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, `@object-ui/console` patch (`Metadata-protocol: none` grades every entry `patch`).

Branch: the harness-assigned `claude/project-thread-lp3y66`, not `claude/issue-30125-*`; the card is #30125.

## Tests

Two new files, one per register page, real `AuthProvider` over a mock client whose `getSession` answers the session the sign-up created:

- `ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/invitationSignUpJoin-30125.test.tsx` (console mounted under a base href of `/_console/`, as the shipped build is): the sign-up accepts exactly the link's invitation, switches to its organization, and makes exactly one navigation, landing on `/_console/`; the server refusing `get-invitation`: nothing accepted, one navigation to `/_console/accept-invitation/ID`; CONTROL: already signed in on arrival, nothing read or accepted.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/__tests__/invitationSignUpJoin-30125.test.tsx`: the same three for `DefaultRegisterPage` (refusal renders the accept route; signed-in arrival renders `/`).

## Acceptance notes

- **Consent boundary.** Accepting stays the invited person's act: only the invitation the page's own link names, only for a session created on that page by registering. An address that is not the invited one gets the server's refusal (403 `get-invitation`, measured live below) and the invitation stays `pending`. Under `invite_only` a sign-up with an address that has no invitation at all is already refused at `sign-up/email` (`SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED`), unchanged.
- **Email verification on.** A sign-up that waits for verification creates no session on the page, so nothing is accepted there; the verification mail returns to the accept page (objectui#10893), one click as before. Not changed here, on purpose: auto-accepting on that page would let any link with a crafted query accept on behalf of a signed-in person.
- **Signing in to an existing account from the invitation link** still goes through the accept page ("Accept invitation", then "Continue"). Item 2 names registration; that path is unchanged.
- On a single-organization deployment the new account is already bound to the default organization at sign-up (ADR-0093 D1/D2), and the acceptance adopts that membership (`adopt-membership.ts`); measured live: the invitation turns `accepted`, the account has one organization.
- The console's post-sign-up effect on main assigned the accept page twice in the mocked flow (seen in ablation 1 below); with the join, every exit happens once.

## Verification

Base `c045c341`. Source head `b81f734a`; the head adds an evidence commit and its removal, the tree is byte-identical to `b81f734a` (`git diff b81f734a HEAD` is empty).

<details><summary>Live rig and screenshots (os dev, zh-CN, 1440 wide)</summary>

`examples/app-showcase`: `pnpm dev -- --fresh -p PORT` (`objectstack dev --seed-admin`, invite_only, single tenancy), console `vite` from `ui/apps/console` with `DEV_PROXY_TARGET` at that port, Playwright Chromium. The administrator (`admin@objectos.ai`) invites a fresh address over `organization/invite-member`; a clean browser opens `/accept-invitation/ID` signed out, follows "注册并加入", registers that address, and the script records every screen it has to act on until an app route.

Before (main `c045c341`, the two register pages restored to the base): sign-up, then `/accept-invitation/ID` with 接受邀请, then 邀请已接受 with 继续, then `/apps/com.example.showcase/...`. Auth requests after the sign-up: `get-invitation` x4, `accept-invitation`, `set-active`.

![before: register](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/665dd1b6a9116408f8608e4ccd8973f937dcb08d/evidence/30125-item2/before-2-register-filled-zh-1440.png?raw=true)
![before: accept page](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/665dd1b6a9116408f8608e4ccd8973f937dcb08d/evidence/30125-item2/before-4-accept-page-zh-1440.png?raw=true)
![before: invitation accepted, continue](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/665dd1b6a9116408f8608e4ccd8973f937dcb08d/evidence/30125-item2/before-5-accepted-continue-zh-1440.png?raw=true)
![before: app](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/665dd1b6a9116408f8608e4ccd8973f937dcb08d/evidence/30125-item2/before-6-landed-zh-1440.png?raw=true)

After (`b81f734a`): sign-up, then `/apps/com.example.showcase/...` directly, 6.6 s after submit. Requests after the sign-up: `get-invitation` x1, `accept-invitation` x1, `set-active` x1. The invitation reads `accepted` in the administrator's `list-invitations`.

![after: register](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/665dd1b6a9116408f8608e4ccd8973f937dcb08d/evidence/30125-item2/after-2-register-filled-zh-1440.png?raw=true)
![after: app, right after the sign-up](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/665dd1b6a9116408f8608e4ccd8973f937dcb08d/evidence/30125-item2/after-3-landed-zh-1440.png?raw=true)

Mismatch (`b81f734a`): A and B are both invited; B registers from A's link. `sign-up/email` 200 (B has an invitation), `get-invitation` 403, no `accept-invitation` request; the page lands on A's accept page, which shows 邀请不可用 / 您不是该邀请的收件人。 Both invitations still `pending`.

![mismatch: the server refusal on the accept page](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/665dd1b6a9116408f8608e4ccd8973f937dcb08d/evidence/30125-item2/after-mismatch-accept-page-refusal-zh-1440.png?raw=true)

</details>

<details><summary>Tests, ablation, typecheck, lint</summary>

- The two new files: Test Files 2 passed (2), Tests 6 passed (6).
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/ packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/ apps/console/src/pages/auth/` on `b81f734a`: Test Files 59 passed (59), Tests 456 passed (456), lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Ablation 1 (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor x1 to x0): the hook never applies (`const applies = false && …`): 4 failed / 2 passed (both join cases and both refusal cases; the CONTROLs stay green). Restored, blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Ablation 2: the signed-out latch dropped from `applies`: 2 failed / 4 passed (both CONTROL cases: an already signed-in visitor would accept). Restored, blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console run type-check`: lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- eslint on the six changed source and test files: 0 errors; the 2 warnings are on console `RegisterPage.tsx` lines this PR does not change.

</details>
